Job Description

Are you an experienced AI/GenAI engineer who loves shipping real systems? Join Stanford’s Enterprise Technology team to design, implement, and support AI solutions across university use cases. In this role, you will influence strategic direction requirements and architecture for AI‑driven information systems, incorporating new capabilities (LLMs, RAG, agentic frameworks, MLOps) to improve workflow, efficiency, and decision-making. You may serve as the technical lead for specific AI tracks and interrelated applications.

This role blends hands-on engineering with mentorship and thought leadership. You will prototype and productionize—presenting proofs of concept, demoing solutions to stakeholders, and partnering with project managers, technical managers, architects, security, infrastructure, and application teams (ServiceNow, Salesforce, Oracle Financials, etc.)

Core Duties

AI/ML System Implementation & Integration: Translate requirements into well-engineered components (pipelines, vector stores, prompt/agent logic, evaluation hooks) and implement them in partnership with the platform/architecture team.
Application & Agent Development: Build and maintain LLM-based agents/services that securely call enterprise tools (ServiceNow, Salesforce, Oracle, etc.) using approved APIs and tool-calling frameworks. Create lightweight internal SDKs/utilities where needed.
RAG & Search Enablement: Configure and optimize RAG workflows (chunking, embeddings, metadata filters) and integrate with existing search/vector infrastructure—escalating architecture changes to designated architects.
MLOps & SDLC Practices: Follow and improve team standards for CI/CD, testing, prompt/model versioning, and observability. Own feature delivery through dev/test/prod, coordinating with release managers.
Governance, Security & Compliance: Apply established guardrails (PII redaction, policy checks, access controls). Partner with InfoSec and architects to close gaps; document decisions and risks.
Metrics & Reporting: Instrument services with KPIs (latency, cost, accuracy/quality) and build lightweight dashboards. Deep BI/reporting not primary.
Documentation & Communication: Write clear technical docs (APIs, workflows, runbooks), user stories, and acceptance criteria. Support and sometimes lead UAT/test activities.
Collaboration & Mentorship: Facilitate working sessions with stakeholders; mentor junior engineers through code reviews and pair programming; provide concise updates and risk flags.

Qualifications

Education & Experience
:

Bachelor's degree and eight years relevant experience, or a combination of education and relevant experience.

Required Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

Agent/Agentic Framework Experience: Built and shipped at least one production LLM agent or agentic workflow using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI/AutoGen, Google Agent Builder/Vertex AI Agents (or equivalent). Able to explain tool selection, orchestration logic, and post‑deployment support.
Proven Delivery: Implemented 3+ AI/ML projects and 2+ GenAI/LLM projects in production, with operational support (monitoring, tuning, incident response). Projects should serve sizable user populations and demonstrate measurable efficiency gains.
Strong understanding of AI/ML concepts (LLMs/transformers and classical ML) and experience designing, developing, testing, and deploying AI-driven applications.
Programming Expertise: Python (primary) plus experience with Node.js/Next.js/React/TypeScript and Java; demonstrated ability to quickly learn new tools/frameworks.
Experience with cloud AI stacks (e.g., Google Vertex AI, AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI) and vector/search technologies (Pinecone, Elastic/OpenSearch, FAISS, Milvus, etc.).
Knowledge of data design/architecture, relational and NoSQL databases, and data modeling.
Thorough understanding of SDLC, MLOps, and quality control practices.
Ability to define/solve logical problems for highly technical applications; strong problem-solving and systematic troubleshooting skills.
Excellent communication, listening, negotiation, and conflict resolution skills; ability to bridge functional and technical resources.

Desired Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
:

MLOps Tooling: MLflow, Kubeflow, Vertex Pipelines, SageMaker Pipelines; LangSmith/PromptLayer/Weights & Biases.
Open Source Savvy: Experience working with, customizing, and improving open-source solutions; comfortable contributing fixes/features upstream.
Rapid Tech Adoption: Demonstrated ability to pick up a new technology/framework quickly and deliver production value with it.
GenAI Frameworks: LangChain, LlamaIndex, DSPy, Haystack, LangGraph, Agent Engine, Google ADK, AWS AgentCore, CrewAI/AutoGen.
Security & Governance: Implementing AI guardrails, red-teaming, policy enforcement frameworks.
Enterprise Integrations: ServiceNow, Salesforce, Oracle Financials or others.
UI Development: React/Next.js/Tailwind for internal tools.
Prompt engineering at scale: Structured prompts (JSON/function-calling), templates, version control; automated/offline & online evals (rubrics, hallucination/bias checks, A/B tests, golden sets).
Parameter‑efficient fine‑tuning (LoRA/QLoRA/adapters), supervised instruction tuning; hosting open‑weight models (Llama/Mistral/Qwen) with vLLM/TGI/Ollama.
Safety/guardrails frameworks (Guardrails.ai, NeMo Guardrails, Azure/AWS safety filters) and jailbreak/drift detection.
Hybrid search & reranking (BM25+dense, Cohere/Voyage/Jina rerankers), synthetic data generation, provenance/watermarking.
Telemetry & governance: prompt/model drift monitoring, policy‑as‑code, audit logging, red‑teaming playbooks.

You will work on cutting-edge technologies including agentic systems, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI platforms, and large-scale knowledge services, enabling teams across Westlaw to deliver intelligent, trustworthy, and high-performing solutions for legal professionals worldwide.

Key Responsibilities

Build and architect AI-driven systems – Design and lead the implementation of enterprise-scale AI systems, including multi-component pipelines, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and knowledge graph–based architectures, and autonomous AI agents with multi-step reasoning; stay hands-on across the stack, from AI orchestration and RAG through API gateways, microservices, and modern web UIs.
Drive innovation and technical strategy – Evaluate and drive adoption of emerging AI techniques; run proof-of-concept work and assess technical feasibility for new AI-driven features; stay current with AI research and translate insights into technical roadmaps; represent the organization at industry conferences and events.
Provide technical leadership – Help make design decisions and translate business requirements into scalable technical specifications; mentor senior and junior software engineers; champion MLOps and LLMOps practices and governance for the AI model lifecycle.
Ensure quality, security, and operational excellence – Design and implement testing, monitoring, and observability for AI systems at scale; ensure compliance with ethical AI principles, security standards, and regulatory requirements.
Lead cross-functional collaboration and drive business value delivery – Partner with AI researchers, engineering leadership, design, and product to turn AI capabilities into customer-facing applications; set technical priorities and stay engaged through delivery so AI investments produce measurable business value; optimize performance for latency, cost, and user experience; influence product strategy through technical depth.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience (Master’s preferred).
5+ years of software engineering experience, including 3 years in senior or lead roles on AI/ML systems.
A track record as a software engineer with AI expertise (not primarily a data scientist or researcher), with hands-on experience in generative AI, RAG, or LLM-based systems, covering discovery, architecture, agentic tools, evaluation, deployment, and metrics.
Expert-level proficiency in Python or another object-oriented language, with strong backend service and API design skills.
Solid understanding of ML principles, evaluation methodologies, and distributed systems, plus working experience with AI/ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow).
Advanced experience with AWS and with Docker, Kubernetes, and Terraform, and a record of integrating AI models into large-scale production systems through APIs, data pipelines, and cloud-native architectures.
Strong technical leadership and mentoring experience as an individual contributor, with the communication skills to influence senior stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience leading technical direction for teams building agent-based systems or enterprise integrations with AI APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic).
Advanced knowledge of vector databases, embeddings, semantic search, and information retrieval.
Hands-on experience with knowledge graphs, including graph data modeling, ontologies and taxonomies, graph databases (e.g., Neo4j, Amazon Neptune), and combining graphs with LLMs through approaches such as GraphRAG and entity extraction.
Domain expertise in legal, tax, accounting, or other regulated industries, or in large-scale search platforms.
Successful AI product launches and experience scaling AI systems to enterprise customers.
Experience with AI governance, model risk management, and regulatory compliance.
Publications, patents, or speaking experience in AI/ML.Jon

Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer, Startups (Physical AI)
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About The Role

As an Applied AI Engineer on the Startups team at Anthropic, you will be a trusted technical advisor to the top AI-native startups building in the physical world, across robotics, semiconductors, aerospace, manufacturing, and civil infrastructure, as they grow from early product to scale. Some of these companies build the hardware itself and want Claude woven into how they design, test, and operate it, and others build the software that engineers everywhere use to design, simulate, test, and scale, and this role works with both. You'll lead deep technical engagements, partnering directly with startup software and hardware engineering teams to help them build their products on Claude and run their own engineering with it, advising on implementation and agent design as they build what is newly possible with AI in the physical world. You will bridge the gap between what Claude can do and what it takes to build real things, working alongside some of the strongest teams in the field on problems that matter and helping mechanical, electrical, and process engineers get the kind of step change that software engineering has had from agentic coding with tools like Claude Code.

Working closely with Applied AI Architects, Account Executives, and Anthropic's Product, Engineering, and Research teams, you'll help startups build at the edge of what is possible with Claude. You'll leverage your AI engineering expertise and your engineering domain knowledge to develop custom evaluation frameworks, design scalable architectures, and create the technical resources that enable physical AI startups to succeed with Claude.

Responsibilities

Serve as a deep technical advisor to high-potential startups building in the physical world, whether Claude sits inside the product they sell or inside the way they design, test, and run their own hardware, working alongside them to push the boundaries of AI in engineering, manufacturing, operations, and more
Work hands-on with startup software and hardware teams through pair programming and architecture reviews that accelerate their development, and understand their engineering workflows end to end, from design and simulation through test, production, and operations, so that your guidance fits how real hardware gets built
Develop prototypes and technical documentation, including evaluation suites, benchmarks grounded in real engineering tasks, AI engineering techniques, and architecture diagrams, that enable startups to build, operate, and scale with Claude
Create reference implementations and sample code that many companies can adopt without starting from scratch, for example integrating Claude with CAD, simulation, design tools, or industrial automation
Collaborate closely with Applied AI Architects to maintain context and continuity across customer engagements
Identify patterns across engagements, including what is hard about applying AI to physical systems such as reading drawings, 3D geometry, board layout and routing, GD&T, latency and on-premise constraints, and physical safety, then build repeatable evaluations and solutions and contribute insights back to Product, Engineering, Research, and the broader Applied AI team
Create technical content for startup audiences including documentation, tutorials, and sample code
Foster community engagement through hackathons, webinars, technical office hours, and startup-focused events
Travel to customer sites for workshops, implementation guidance, and relationship building

You may be a good fit if you have

Deep engineering experience in a physical discipline such as mechanical, electrical, aerospace, robotics, semiconductor, manufacturing, or civil engineering, gained by designing, building, or operating real hardware, along with strong opinions of your own about how to bridge the gap between what AI can do today and how physical things get built
4+ years of technical experience as a software engineer, ML or research engineer, robotics or controls engineer, hardware or systems engineer, or technical founder, with either production experience building LLM-powered applications, including prompting, context engineering, agent architectures, evaluation frameworks, and deployment at scale, or a track record of successfully applying AI to real engineering work in design, simulation, test, or production
Experience with startups or high-growth companies and a love of working with founders and small teams that move quickly
Strong technical communication skills, with the ability to translate complex AI concepts into architectural decisions and actionable implementation plans for both software and hardware engineering audiences and to run technical workshops, hackathons, or developer-focused events
A collaborative approach to working across teams, the range of a generalist who can context-switch from robots to chips to rockets to factories and get up to speed on a new domain quickly, and a passion for making powerful technology safe and beneficial

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary

$280,000—$320,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education:
Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study:
A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience:
Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy:
Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship:
We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.
Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us.
To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How We're Different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

Location: Anywhere in Country

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

The Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced Responsible AI and AI governance professional with 5+ years of experience who is passionate about helping organizations adopt AI responsibly, from strategy through hands-on implementation. In this role, you will assess AI and technology governance maturity, design Responsible AI frameworks and control objectives, and implement those controls across the AI lifecycle, embedding them into platforms, data pipelines, MLOps/LLMOps workflows, access models, and GRC tooling. You will move clients from policy to practice by configuring governance tooling, automating evidence collection, standing up monitoring and guardrails, and operationalizing target-state operating models across people, process, policy, and technology. Your ability to connect business strategy, risk, and technology to build trusted, scalable, and auditable AI programs will be crucial.

Your Key Responsibilities

In this pivotal role, you will:

Lead current-state assessments and peer benchmarking of AI and technology governance structures, policies, processes, and technology capabilities to define target-state design and prioritized remediation.
Design and implement Responsible AI control frameworks, translating regulatory and policy requirements into control objectives, technical control specifications, evidence standards, and testing procedures.
Implement technical Responsible AI controls across the AI lifecycle, including use-case intake, risk tiering, bias and fairness testing, explainability, LLM guardrails, content safety, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and continuous monitoring.
Configure and deploy AI governance, data governance, and GRC platforms to operationalize AI inventories, model registries, approval workflows, lineage, and automated evidence collection.
Embed governance controls into MLOps/LLMOps and CI/CD pipelines (e.g., pre-deployment gates, evaluation checks, logging, and audit trails) so controls are enforced by design rather than reviewed after the fact.
Design and implement access governance, role-based access, and segregation of duties controls across ERP and cloud AI environments (e.g., Oracle Cloud, Azure, AWS), balancing security, efficiency, and user experience.
Drive deployment, adoption, and sustainment of governance programs through phased roadmaps, control testing, operating procedures, runbooks, and handover to client teams.
Travel as required to meet client needs and project demands.

Stakeholder management

Foster strong relationships with clients, acting as a trusted advisor from governance design through build, deployment, and go-live.
Facilitate workshops with business, technology, data science, risk, legal, and compliance stakeholders to translate obligations into implementable technical and process requirements.
Collaborate with clients and stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable, operable solutions, and partner with engineering and platform teams to deliver them.

Team and People development

Provide leadership and development of junior resources
Build an organizational culture that fosters inclusion and innovation.
Create an environment that fosters professional and career development.
Develop and mentor junior team members, fostering a culture of continuous learning and growth.

Skills And Attributes For Success

To excel in this role, you will need:

Proven ability to take governance programs from assessment and design through implementation and sustainment.
Strong understanding of Responsible AI, AI governance, and AI risk management principles, and how to translate them into technical controls.
Hands-on experience implementing controls in AI/ML platforms, data platforms, and GRC tools, not only documenting them.
Working knowledge of IT general controls, identity and access management, and segregation of duties.
Experience delivering large-scale, multi-region enterprise transformation and implementation programs.
Strong analytical skills to develop creative, practical solutions for complex problems.
Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to bridge executive, risk, and engineering audiences.
Demonstrated emotional agility and the ability to collaborate in hybrid environments.

Experience:

A Bachelor’s degree and 3-6 years of experience in technology risk, AI/data governance, or technology consulting, including hands-on implementation delivery
Experience conducting governance maturity and gap assessments and delivering the resulting remediation and control implementations
Hands-on experience configuring and deploying governance, monitoring, or access controls in cloud, AI/ML, or ERP environments
Experience implementing ERP security and governance (e.g., Oracle Cloud), including role design, provisioning workflows, and segregation of duties controls

Skillsets:

AI Governance & Frameworks: Responsible AI policies, control objectives, evidence standards; NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, EU AI Act
AI Governance Platforms: Microsoft Purview, IBM watsonx.governance, Credo AI, ServiceNow AI governance / IRM (or similar)
Cloud AI Platforms: Azure AI Foundry / Azure Machine Learning, AWS SageMaker / Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, Databricks
MLOps / LLMOps: MLflow, model registries, model cards, CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps) with automated governance gates
Bias, Fairness & Explainability: Fairlearn, IBM AI Fairness 360, SHAP, LIME, SageMaker Clarify
GenAI Guardrails & Safety: Azure AI Content Safety, Amazon Bedrock Guardrails, NVIDIA NeMo Guardrails, prompt injection defenses, PII redaction
AI Evaluation & Red Teaming: LLM evaluation frameworks, adversarial testing tools (e.g., PyRIT, Garak), groundedness and hallucination testing
Monitoring & Observability: Model drift and performance monitoring, AI/agent inventory and observability, logging and audit trails (Azure Monitor, CloudWatch, Datadog)
Data Governance & Privacy: Data classification, lineage, and cataloging (Microsoft Purview, Collibra, Unity Catalog); consent and privacy controls
Identity & Access: Microsoft Entra ID, RBAC/ABAC, privileged access management, Oracle Cloud role design and segregation of duties
GRC & Control Automation: ServiceNow IRM, Archer, or AuditBoard; automated control testing and evidence collection
Programming & Data: Python and SQL for control automation, testing, and evidence reporting; Power BI for governance dashboards
Certification in AIGP and/or CISA (preferred); cloud AI certifications such as Azure AI Engineer or AWS Machine Learning (good to have)
Professional memberships such as IAPP or ISACA (good to have)

To qualify for the role, you must have:

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
Specialized skills in AI Governance, Responsible AI, Technology Risk, and Access Governance, with demonstrated experience implementing technical controls.
Well-developed business acumen and strong problem-solving attitude with the ability to visualize scenarios, possible outcomes & operating constraints.

Familiarity with the evolving AI regulatory landscape and ability to translate it into deployable technical solutions.

jobs.title: Founding Research Engineer
jobs.description:
About Parisi Labs

Parisi Labs is building foundational world models for physical industry. We are developing models that learn how complex physical systems behave and reuse that understanding across forecasts, scenarios, and operational decisions.

Energy is our first proving ground. We combine historical and live data with operational context, bringing together machine learning research, data infrastructure, and software engineering to turn advances in modeling into useful technology for energy operators.

We are a small technical team working directly with the founders on our core models, systems, and products.

About The Role

We are looking for an ML Data Platform Engineer to make the data behind our models, products, and customer deployments dependable, understandable, and easy to use.

This role sits where data engineering meets machine learning. You will turn messy, changing real-world sources into durable datasets and interfaces that researchers and engineers can trust. Your work will support both public data and customer-authorized operational data.

The goal is not to build a large platform for its own sake. It is to make each new model, product capability, and data source faster to bring online without compromising correctness. You will own the shared data foundations, working with the applied-AI engineer on model requirements and the product engineer on application needs.

What You'll Own

Build and improve ingestion, backfills, validation, and observability for high-volume, time-dependent data.
Define clear data contracts and point-in-time semantics for model training, evaluation, and product use.
Create reusable workflows for bringing public and customer-authorized sources into the system.
Build quality, lineage, freshness, and access controls that make data trustworthy in repeated use.
Develop efficient datasets and query interfaces for machine-learning and product workloads.
Diagnose whether failures originate in source data, transformations, model inputs, or serving systems.
Work with researchers and engineers to turn recurring data requirements into reliable software rather than manual projects.
Decide which abstractions should become shared infrastructure and which should remain purpose-built.

What We're Looking For

A record of designing, building, and operating production data systems that researchers or engineers depend on.
Strong programming, querying, and data-modeling skills, with the ability to write maintainable, tested production software.
An understanding of time-dependent data correctness, including backfills, revisions, freshness, and point-in-time availability.
Experience supporting ML training and evaluation, or similarly demanding data-intensive product workloads.
The ability to design practical data contracts, validation, observability, and access controls without overbuilding the platform.
Strong debugging and collaboration skills, including the ability to trace failures across systems and explain data limitations clearly.

First 90 days

30 days: Understand the data lifecycle behind Ask The Grid and our ML work, and identify the most consequential reliability and usability gaps.
60 days: Ship a reusable ingestion, backfill, validation, or dataset capability used in active product or research work.
90 days: Own a dependable end-to-end data workflow, with documented contracts, quality checks, and clear operational visibility.

Why join

The quality of our models and products depends on the quality of their underlying data. You will shape that foundation early, working directly with researchers and engineers who use it, and see your work support new experiments, product capabilities, and customer deployments.

Location and compensation

Location: New York City or Boston/Cambridge. This is a hybrid role — we expect in-person collaboration 3 days per week in person.

Salary range: $175,000–$245,000 USD.

Equity: meaningful early-company equity.

jobs.title: AID&E - AI Governance & Responsible AI - Senior - Consulting
jobs.description:
Location: Anywhere in Country

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

The Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced Responsible AI and AI governance professional with 5+ years of experience who is passionate about helping organizations adopt AI responsibly, from strategy through hands-on implementation. In this role, you will assess AI and technology governance maturity, design Responsible AI frameworks and control objectives, and implement those controls across the AI lifecycle, embedding them into platforms, data pipelines, MLOps/LLMOps workflows, access models, and GRC tooling. You will move clients from policy to practice by configuring governance tooling, automating evidence collection, standing up monitoring and guardrails, and operationalizing target-state operating models across people, process, policy, and technology. Your ability to connect business strategy, risk, and technology to build trusted, scalable, and auditable AI programs will be crucial.

Your Key Responsibilities

In this pivotal role, you will:

Lead current-state assessments and peer benchmarking of AI and technology governance structures, policies, processes, and technology capabilities to define target-state design and prioritized remediation.
Design and implement Responsible AI control frameworks, translating regulatory and policy requirements into control objectives, technical control specifications, evidence standards, and testing procedures.
Implement technical Responsible AI controls across the AI lifecycle, including use-case intake, risk tiering, bias and fairness testing, explainability, LLM guardrails, content safety, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and continuous monitoring.
Configure and deploy AI governance, data governance, and GRC platforms to operationalize AI inventories, model registries, approval workflows, lineage, and automated evidence collection.
Embed governance controls into MLOps/LLMOps and CI/CD pipelines (e.g., pre-deployment gates, evaluation checks, logging, and audit trails) so controls are enforced by design rather than reviewed after the fact.
Design and implement access governance, role-based access, and segregation of duties controls across ERP and cloud AI environments (e.g., Oracle Cloud, Azure, AWS), balancing security, efficiency, and user experience.
Drive deployment, adoption, and sustainment of governance programs through phased roadmaps, control testing, operating procedures, runbooks, and handover to client teams.
Travel as required to meet client needs and project demands.

Stakeholder management

Foster strong relationships with clients, acting as a trusted advisor from governance design through build, deployment, and go-live.
Facilitate workshops with business, technology, data science, risk, legal, and compliance stakeholders to translate obligations into implementable technical and process requirements.
Collaborate with clients and stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable, operable solutions, and partner with engineering and platform teams to deliver them.

Team and People development

Provide leadership and development of junior resources
Build an organizational culture that fosters inclusion and innovation.
Create an environment that fosters professional and career development.
Develop and mentor junior team members, fostering a culture of continuous learning and growth.

Skills And Attributes For Success

To excel in this role, you will need:

Proven ability to take governance programs from assessment and design through implementation and sustainment.
Strong understanding of Responsible AI, AI governance, and AI risk management principles, and how to translate them into technical controls.
Hands-on experience implementing controls in AI/ML platforms, data platforms, and GRC tools, not only documenting them.
Working knowledge of IT general controls, identity and access management, and segregation of duties.
Experience delivering large-scale, multi-region enterprise transformation and implementation programs.
Strong analytical skills to develop creative, practical solutions for complex problems.
Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to bridge executive, risk, and engineering audiences.
Demonstrated emotional agility and the ability to collaborate in hybrid environments.

Experience:

A Bachelor’s degree and 3-6 years of experience in technology risk, AI/data governance, or technology consulting, including hands-on implementation delivery
Experience conducting governance maturity and gap assessments and delivering the resulting remediation and control implementations
Hands-on experience configuring and deploying governance, monitoring, or access controls in cloud, AI/ML, or ERP environments
Experience implementing ERP security and governance (e.g., Oracle Cloud), including role design, provisioning workflows, and segregation of duties controls

Skillsets:

AI Governance & Frameworks: Responsible AI policies, control objectives, evidence standards; NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, EU AI Act
AI Governance Platforms: Microsoft Purview, IBM watsonx.governance, Credo AI, ServiceNow AI governance / IRM (or similar)
Cloud AI Platforms: Azure AI Foundry / Azure Machine Learning, AWS SageMaker / Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, Databricks
MLOps / LLMOps: MLflow, model registries, model cards, CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps) with automated governance gates
Bias, Fairness & Explainability: Fairlearn, IBM AI Fairness 360, SHAP, LIME, SageMaker Clarify
GenAI Guardrails & Safety: Azure AI Content Safety, Amazon Bedrock Guardrails, NVIDIA NeMo Guardrails, prompt injection defenses, PII redaction
AI Evaluation & Red Teaming: LLM evaluation frameworks, adversarial testing tools (e.g., PyRIT, Garak), groundedness and hallucination testing
Monitoring & Observability: Model drift and performance monitoring, AI/agent inventory and observability, logging and audit trails (Azure Monitor, CloudWatch, Datadog)
Data Governance & Privacy: Data classification, lineage, and cataloging (Microsoft Purview, Collibra, Unity Catalog); consent and privacy controls
Identity & Access: Microsoft Entra ID, RBAC/ABAC, privileged access management, Oracle Cloud role design and segregation of duties
GRC & Control Automation: ServiceNow IRM, Archer, or AuditBoard; automated control testing and evidence collection
Programming & Data: Python and SQL for control automation, testing, and evidence reporting; Power BI for governance dashboards
Certification in AIGP and/or CISA (preferred); cloud AI certifications such as Azure AI Engineer or AWS Machine Learning (good to have)
Professional memberships such as IAPP or ISACA (good to have)

To qualify for the role, you must have:

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
Specialized skills in AI Governance, Responsible AI, Technology Risk, and Access Governance, with demonstrated experience implementing technical controls.
Well-developed business acumen and strong problem-solving attitude with the ability to visualize scenarios, possible outcomes & operating constraints.
Good communication skills both written and oral, ability to make impactful presentations & expertise at using excel & PPTs.
Familiarity with the evolving AI regulatory landscape and ability to translate it into deployable technical solutions.
Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to scale engagements at will.

Ideally, you’ll also have:

A proactive approach to identifying and solving client issues.
Experience across global or multi-region engagements.
Experience implementing agentic AI governance controls (agent inventory, permissions, and observability).
Excellent communication and leadership skills to guide teams and interact with clients.

What We Look For

We are seeking top performers who demonstrate creativity in solving complex problems, have a track record of designing and implementing successful governance and risk programs, and can navigate the intricacies of client and team management. Ideal candidates will bring a blend of governance expertise, hands-on implementation depth, strategic thinking, and leadership skills to drive trusted, responsible AI adoption in our AI & Data practice.

What We Offer You

At EY, we harness our collective strength to empower you to shape your future with confidence through professional growth, personal fulfillment and an inclusive culture. Learn more at ey.com/us/careers.

The salary range for this job is:
New York City, Boston, and Washington DC Metro Areas, Washington State, and Southern California offices – $128,400 to $192,500
Bay Area California offices – $133,600 to $200,600
All other offices locations in the US, including Sacramento – $106,900 to $176,500

Individual salaries within these ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.

To make the most of your application experience, please limit yourself to two applications within a six-month period.
EY accepts applications for this position on an on-going basis.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

jobs.description:
Company:
Celerity Consulting Group

Job Title:
Solution Architect (Multiple openings available)

Salary:
$165,000.00 - $185,000.00 + bonus potential

Location:
Remote (work for home eligible) Light travel may be required

Company Overview
: Celerity is a consulting firm specializing in system integration solutions for the utilities and energy sectors. We empower organizations by converting complex data into actionable intelligence to mitigate risk, optimize assets, and maximize project outcomes. Our background and expertise enable us to deliver Field Service Management (FSM) solutions, driving digital transformation and operational excellence for our clients.

Position Overview:

We are seeking an experienced Solution Architect with over 10 years of expertise in Field Service Management tools and a strong background in the utilities and energy industries. The successful candidate will lead the design and implementation of the FSM solution, ensuring they meet client requirements and industry best practices. This role will also be responsible for building and mentoring a high-performing team to deliver exceptional service to our clients.

Key Responsibilities
:

Solution Design and Architecture:

Lead the design of comprehensive FSM solutions tailored to the specific needs of clients in the utilities and energy sectors
Develop detailed architectural blueprints that outline system integrations, data flows, and technical specifications
Ensure solutions are scalable, secure, and aligned with industry standards and best practices

Technical Leadership:

Provide technical guidance and oversight during the implementation of FSM solutions, ensuring adherence to architectural designs and project timelines
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including developers, project managers, and business analysts, to ensure cohesive and efficient project delivery
Stay abreast of emerging technologies and industry trends to inform solution design and implementation strategies

Client Engagement:

Engage with clients to understand their business processes, requirements, and challenges
Translate client needs into functional and technical requirements, ensuring clear communication and alignment throughout the project lifecycle
Present architectural solutions and design decisions to clients, articulating the benefits and rationale behind chosen approaches

Team Building and Mentorship:

Recruit, mentor, and develop a team of technical professionals, fostering a culture of continuous learning and excellence
Define team roles, responsibilities, and performance expectations to ensure clarity and accountability
Provide ongoing training and development opportunities to enhance team capabilities and knowledge of FSM solutions

Quality Assurance and Continuous Improvement:

Establish and enforce best practices for solution design, coding standards, and system integrations
Conduct regular code and design reviews to ensure quality and adherence to architectural standards
Identify opportunities for process improvements and implement solutions to enhance efficiency and effectiveness in solution delivery

Educational Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field
Advanced degree (MBA or Master’s) is preferred

Required Skills and Experience:

Minimum of 10 years of experience in implementing Field Service Management or similar solutions, with a significant focus on the utilities and energy industries required
Proven track record of leading complex FSM implementations, and integrating with existing technology stack (ERP, CRM, CIS, BI, Datawarehouse, etc.)
Experience with development of Web-based business applications, using some of the following: XML, JSON, HTML 5, Angular JS, etc
Experience with cloud-based FSM platforms (Salesforce Field Service, Oracle Field Service, ServiceNow FSM, Click)
Familiarity with cloud architectures (AWS, Azure, GCP)
Experience with planning, designing, and developing integration solutions to integrate with enterprise systems using SOAP & REST web services
Experience working in Agile or hybrid delivery models, including backlog management and iterative solution delivery
Strong understanding of utility operations, asset management, and regulatory compliance
Demonstrated experience in team building and leadership, with the ability to inspire and develop talent
Excellent project management skills, including proficiency in project planning, execution, and risk management
Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively engage clients and stakeholders at all levels
Technical proficiency in FSM software platforms, system integration, and data analytics
Ability to travel to client site (domestic and(or) international) as required and defined per project requirements

Preferred Skills:

Consulting background with experience in client-facing roles delivering high-impact programs
Familiarity with GIS integration and mobile workforce management solutions
Knowledge of emerging technologies such as IoT, AI, and Machine Learning as they apply to Field Service Management
Professional certifications in solution architecture or relevant technical areas

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Driving Product
jobs.description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About Our Driving Product Teams

The Driving Product team builds the AI driver's core behaviours, taking models from data and training through evaluation and on-road validation, then shipping them into the car on timelines measured in months, not years. The team's work has direct impact on high-priority commercial deliveries, including Nissan production and Robotaxi, and spans the full spectrum from Level 2 to Level 4 driving. It's a small, high-ownership team at a point of rapid growth, blending ML research with shipping-focused engineering.

🧠 Your day-to-day

Develop the AI driver model architecture and training algorithms to introduce and enhance driving behaviours for L2/L3/L4
Own key parts of the training model lifecycle, including evaluation strategy, success metrics, and iteration planning
Mine, bucket, and curate real-world and synthetic data to teach specific driving behaviours, and implement data schemes to support training
Run and analyse on-road and offline experiments, translate results into clear next steps, and drive improvements through repeated training cycles

🧩 What You'll Be Working On

Models that predict vehicle trajectories and interact directly with controllers and actuators, closing the loop between prediction and real-world vehicle performance
End-to-end work across data, model training, evaluation, deployment, and performance monitoring
On-road and off-road metrics that diagnose issues and drive data-led model iterations
Production-ready ML systems built with strong software engineering, quality, and reliability practices
Methods spanning reinforcement learning, behavioural cloning, and distillation, working with multi-sensor inputs such as camera, radar, and lidar where relevant

👤 You Should Apply If

Proven track record training deep learning models with clear end-to-end ownership: data, training, evaluation, and iteration
You've taken ML models into production, working through real-world constraints, quality, and safety requirements
Strong Python skills and hands-on experience with modern ML frameworks
Comfortable shipping production-facing ML, not just research or proof-of-concept work
Background in either end-to-end autonomous driving/embodied AI, or large-scale product ML systems such as recommendations or ranking
Bring reinforcement learning or behavioural cloning experience, especially where it materially improved real-world performance
Familiar with model compression and deploying ML to embedded systems (nice to have)

🌱 Not ticking every box? That's totally okay! If you're passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every requirement.

More About Wayve

🚗 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve's mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

How we work 💻 — Locations & Flexible Working:

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

📋 The Interview Process

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

Initial call / recruiter screen (30 mins)
Competency interviews (programming and system design; 2 hours)
Deep-dive technical interviews (Hiring manager interview, Applied ML interview and Pytorch debugging interview; 3 hours)
Final interview: mission & values alignment (45 minutes)

We'll always explain the format and work around your availability.

What's in it for you (Location dependent):

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually

📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve

✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable

✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs

📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth

🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partner discounts and more

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

For more information visit Careers at Wayve. To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve

DISCLAIMER: We will not ask about marriage or pregnancy, care responsibilities or disabilities in any of our job adverts or interviews. However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory.

jobs.description:
Why Blee

Blee is an AI-first marketing content compliance platform. PayPal, NerdWallet, and Brex already trust us. We're YC-backed, founded by an ex-Adobe marketing ops leader and former lawyer, and we're defining a category that didn't exist two years ago—across Fintech, Financial Services, CPG, Travel, and Life Sciences..

With offices in San Francisco and New York, we value in-person work but offer remote-opportunities for the right people. No matter where you join us, you can expect quarterly off-sites and opportunities to join other offices when you feel it’s important. You’ll be joining a team that values clarity, ownership, and shared responsibility—and is focused on building something that genuinely improves how teams work.

The Role

This is an Applied Scientist role specializing in agent system design for someone who wants to architect and implement the next generation of intelligent compliance systems. You will design frameworks where multiple agents—powered by custom and foundational models—work together to surface, track, and explain compliance flags. You will also build and optimize applied AI/ML pipelines, work across model fine-tuning, prompt engineering, evaluation frameworks, and customer-specific AI configurations, and train models based on user feedback to provide more targeted compliance recommendations.

What You'll Do

Architect multi-agent systems – Design and implement frameworks that integrate foundational LLMs and custom-trained models to power intelligent compliance workflows
Build and optimize AI/ML pipelines – Model fine-tuning, prompt engineering, and evaluation frameworks
Ensure explainability and traceability – Build mechanisms for transparent flagging, ensuring every compliance flag is traceable to prior rules, examples, or data assets
Automate compliance rule translation – Build systems that transform compliance rules into agent-ready logic paths
Design, train, and fine-tune models – Improve compliance accuracy and adaptability using user feedback and outcomes data to drive iterative training and personalization
Design model evaluation and monitoring infrastructure – Ensure reliability and auditability across customer deployments
Collaborate cross-functionally – Work with Product Engineers to integrate AI features via APIs, data pipelines, and frontend; partner with model training engineers to incorporate feedback loops into system design; collaborate with compliance users to translate complex rules into agent workflows
Stay current on AI/ML advances – Prototype and apply new techniques to our platform

Who You Are

Deeply technical and hands-on – you love building production ML systems, not just prototyping
Customer-outcome oriented – you care about how your models perform in the real world, not just on benchmarks
A fast learner who thrives at the intersection of AI and domain-specific problems, especially compliance and governance
Strong collaborator who can work across engineering, product, compliance, and customer-facing teams
Proactive and curious; you stay ahead of the rapidly evolving AI landscape
Excited to work in a high-trust, high-autonomy environment where your work directly impacts customers

Who You'll Work With

You will work closely with Blee's AI and engineering leadership, collaborating daily with product engineers and implementation managers.

Requirements

5+ years of applied ML/AI engineering experience
Strong knowledge of agent-based architectures and orchestration frameworks
Strong Python; proficiency with modern software engineering practices (APIs, microservices, distributed systems)
ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face)
LLM experience: fine-tuning, prompt engineering, RAG, evaluation
Background in data preprocessing, feature engineering, and training pipelines
Production ML: model serving, monitoring, A/B testing, data pipelines
Strong communication skills and ability to work cross-functionally
Based in the Bay Area or NY & willing to come into the office 2-3 days a week

How We Work

We have offices in New York and San Francisco and value in-person collaboration, but we're open to remote for the right person. Wherever you're based, expect bi-annual off-sites and the chance to spend time in our other offices when it matters.

What You’ll Get

Competitive salary and equity package
Bi-annual get-togethers

Company-sponsored 401k + matching (US Only)

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.

The Role

The Applied AI team works embedded with Addepar's strategic clients to figure out where AI can change how they work and then build those capabilities from scratch. You'll spend time understanding a client's world, identify what's worth building, prototype it, prove it works, and then partner with core engineering teams to ship it as product for all customers.

As an Applied AI Engineer, you'll build agentic systems from idea through production. The work starts with understanding the problem well enough to know what to build, then moves fast through prototyping and iteration. You'll design agent behavior, wire up tool integrations, tune evaluations until the AI actually works in practice. You'll sit close to the people who use what you build, and that feedback loop is how both the product and your skills grow fast. The team is new. Your work shapes what we ship.

This role may require occasional work outside standard business hours to accommodate client time zones and up to 15% travel to client sites, including occasional overnight and multi-day engagements.

Build AI-powered agents and tools end-to-end: identify the problem with clients and domain experts, prototype quickly, evaluate rigorously, and ship to production
Design and implement LLM integrations including prompt engineering, function calling, structured outputs, and retrieval-augmented workflows
Define evaluation criteria and build test harnesses for AI systems where correctness is ambiguous and domain-specific
Work directly with clients to understand their workflows, validate AI behavior, and iterate toward production quality
Partner with core engineering teams to generalize client-specific work into product features
Contribute to shared AI infrastructure (agent frameworks, tool integrations, deployment pipelines)
Monitor and maintain production AI systems with attention to reliability, cost, and performance

Who You Are

3+ years of professional software engineering experience
Professional experience with Python (the team's primary language)
Experience working with LLM APIs (Claude, GPT, or similar) including function calling and structured outputs
Comfort with SQL for data exploration and building data-grounded AI workflows
Experience with AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Codex, or similar)

BS/MS in Computer Science, Mathematics, or another quantitative field, or equivalent experience

Experience building agentic systems (multi-step tool use, agent orchestration, durable workflows)
Experience with additional backend languages (Java is valuable in our environment)
Familiarity with financial data (portfolios, transactions, securities, accounting)
Exposure to cloud infrastructure (AWS) and container-based deployments
Experience with evaluation frameworks or methodologies for measuring AI system quality

We are hiring an AI Engineer to build and operate the data, features, and GenAI foundations that power Human Capital AI products and analytics. You will work with an AI Data Engineer (data ingestion, curation, governance, platform foundations) and a Lead AI Solutions Architect (end-to-end solution architecture, integration patterns, non-functional requirements), partnering closely with product, data science/ML, security, and platform engineering to deliver reliable, secure, and scalable AI solutions.

This role is hands-on and delivery-oriented: you will ship production pipelines and services that support model training, real-time inference, and LLM applications using Claude-, GPT/Codex-, Gemini-class, and other models, with strong governance, observability, and cost/performance discipline.

Recruiting for this role ends on 10/30/2026.

Work you'll do

As an AI and Data Science Engineer II on the HC Forward team, you will be responsible for designing, building, and running the trusted, governed data, feature, and retrieval layer used by artificial intelligence/machine learning (AI/ML) and generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) solutions. You will deliver reproducible datasets and features, operationalize quality and lineage, and enable secure consumption patterns for predictive machine learning (ML) and large language model (LLM)-based experiences.

Partner with the Lead AI Solutions Architect and AI Data Engineer to translate Human Capital product needs into secure, scalable technical designs and delivered solutions, including application programming interfaces (APIs), services, pipelines, and containers/serverless solutions that meet availability, performance, and security expectations.
Build and operationalize LLM-enabled capabilities, including copilots, human resources (HR) knowledge assistants, summarization, and policy question-and-answer experiences, using Claude/GPT(Codex)/Gemini, including secure endpoints, tool/function calling, and reusable prompt/context patterns.
Implement LLM application patterns, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), document ingestion/chunking, embeddings, vector/hybrid search, and retrieval/evaluation telemetry.
Deliver governed datasets and feature engineering/serving for ML training and real-time inference, including online/offline consistency, caching, latency service-level objectives (SLOs), and backfills.
Operationalize data quality and lineage and enable secure consumption patterns for predictive ML and LLM-based experiences.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
Effective written and verbal communication skills
Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
Ability to lead projects or workstreams
Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
Ability to meet deadlines

2+ years building and delivering large language model (LLM) and generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) solutions with Claude/GPT(Codex)/Gemini-class models, including prompt/context design, tool/function calling, evaluation, and production integration; and 2+ years implementing retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)/retrieval, including document processing, embeddings, vector/hybrid search, and enterprise governance controls.

2+ years leading platform/integration engineering across enterprise systems, including API/integration experience with Representational State Transfer (REST), GraphQL, event-driven capabilities, microservices, and middleware; and 2+ years of development operations (DevOps) and development, security, and operations (DevSecOps) experience, including continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD), infrastructure as code (IaC) using Terraform/CloudFormation, Docker/Kubernetes, observability, and monitoring.
2+ years leading security/compliance efforts, including enterprise security controls-identity and access management (IAM), encryption, secrets, and audit logging-and data/privacy controls-personally identifiable information (PII), retention, and access controls.
Ability to travel 0-25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.

Preferred:

Master's or doctoral degree and/or cloud and artificial intelligence/machine learning (AI/ML) certifications.
2+ years of experience with Human Capital platforms and integrations, including Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM, Salesforce, and human resources (HR) data domains.
2+ years of experience operationalizing large language model operations (LLMOps) and machine learning operations (MLOps) capabilities, including evaluation, monitoring, governance workflows, and model/prompt/version management; and 2+ years of cloud experience with one or more of Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including managed data platforms and compute patterns.
2+ years translating business needs into documented requirements, acceptance criteria, and shippable increments using structured problem solving; and 2+ years documenting and communicating AI/GenAI trade-offs involving quality, latency, cost, and risk to stakeholders.
2+ years collaborating across product, data science/machine learning, data engineering, platform, and security functions; and 2+ years performing threat testing, monitoring, and operational-readiness responsibilities.
2+ years applying ethics and privacy practices to recognize consent, personally identifiable information (PII), and bias boundaries and escalate concerns; and experience with System and Organization Controls (SOC) 2, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), or the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA).

This role is hands-on and delivery-oriented: you will ship production pipelines and services that support model training, real-time inference, and LLM applications using Claude-, GPT/Codex-, Gemini-class, and other models, with strong governance, observability, and cost/performance discipline.

Recruiting for this role ends on 10/30/2026.

Work you'll do

As an AI and Data Science Engineer II on the HC Forward team, you will be responsible for designing, building, and running the trusted, governed data, feature, and retrieval layer used by artificial intelligence/machine learning (AI/ML) and generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) solutions. You will deliver reproducible datasets and features, operationalize quality and lineage, and enable secure consumption patterns for predictive machine learning (ML) and large language model (LLM)-based experiences.

Partner with the Lead AI Solutions Architect and AI Data Engineer to translate Human Capital product needs into secure, scalable technical designs and delivered solutions, including application programming interfaces (APIs), services, pipelines, and containers/serverless solutions that meet availability, performance, and security expectations.
Build and operationalize LLM-enabled capabilities, including copilots, human resources (HR) knowledge assistants, summarization, and policy question-and-answer experiences, using Claude/GPT(Codex)/Gemini, including secure endpoints, tool/function calling, and reusable prompt/context patterns.

Operationalize data quality and lineage and enable secure consumption patterns for predictive ML and LLM-based experiences.

Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
Effective written and verbal communication skills
Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
Ability to lead projects or workstreams
Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
Ability to meet deadlines
Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

HC Forward is a dedicated innovation partner accelerating the future of Human Capital by building market-aligned products, platforms, and services that apply AI, data, and engineering to modernize HR experiences and outcomes.

Qualifications

Required:

Bachelor's degree in a STEM field (e.g., Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Data Science)
2+ years building and delivering large language model (LLM) and generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) solutions with Claude/GPT(Codex)/Gemini-class models, including prompt/context design, tool/function calling, evaluation, and production integration; and 2+ years implementing retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)/retrieval, including document processing, embeddings, vector/hybrid search, and enterprise governance controls.
2+ years of data and artificial intelligence engineering, including data modeling, batch/streaming pipelines, structured/unstructured processing, and feature engineering/serving fundamentals; and 2+ years building production, real-time inference services, including application programming interface (API) design, latency/performance, and reliability patterns.
2+ years leading platform/integration engineering across enterprise systems, including API/integration experience with Representational State Transfer (REST), GraphQL, event-driven capabilities, microservices, and middleware; and 2+ years of development operations (DevOps) and development, security, and operations (DevSecOps) experience, including continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD), infrastructure as code (IaC) using Terraform/CloudFormation, Docker/Kubernetes, observability, and monitoring.
2+ years leading security/compliance efforts, including enterprise security controls-identity and access management (IAM), encryption, secrets, and audit logging-and data/privacy controls-personally identifiable information (PII), retention, and access controls.
Ability to travel 0-25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.

Master's or doctoral degree and/or cloud and artificial intelligence/machine learning (AI/ML) certifications.
2+ years of experience with Human Capital platforms and integrations, including Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM, Salesforce, and human resources (HR) data domains.
2+ years of experience operationalizing large language model operations (LLMOps) and machine learning operations (MLOps) capabilities, including evaluation, monitoring, governance workflows, and model/prompt/version management; and 2+ years of cloud experience with one or more of Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including managed data platforms and compute patterns.

new_jobs.description:
Who We Are

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.

The Role

The Applied AI team works embedded with Addepar's strategic clients to figure out where AI can change how they work and then build those capabilities from scratch. You'll spend time understanding a client's world, identify what's worth building, prototype it, prove it works, and then partner with core engineering teams to ship it as product for all customers.

As an Applied AI Engineer, you'll build agentic systems from idea through production. The work starts with understanding the problem well enough to know what to build, then moves fast through prototyping and iteration. You'll design agent behavior, wire up tool integrations, tune evaluations until the AI actually works in practice. You'll sit close to the people who use what you build, and that feedback loop is how both the product and your skills grow fast. The team is new. Your work shapes what we ship.

This role may require occasional work outside standard business hours to accommodate client time zones and up to 15% travel to client sites, including occasional overnight and multi-day engagements.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without requiring current or future visa sponsorship (for example, employment-based visas such as H-1B, F-1/OPT, or similar), and must be authorized to begin work in the U.S. on their first day of employment.

What You'll Do

Build AI-powered agents and tools end-to-end: identify the problem with clients and domain experts, prototype quickly, evaluate rigorously, and ship to production
Design and implement LLM integrations including prompt engineering, function calling, structured outputs, and retrieval-augmented workflows
Define evaluation criteria and build test harnesses for AI systems where correctness is ambiguous and domain-specific
Work directly with clients to understand their workflows, validate AI behavior, and iterate toward production quality
Partner with core engineering teams to generalize client-specific work into product features
Contribute to shared AI infrastructure (agent frameworks, tool integrations, deployment pipelines)
Monitor and maintain production AI systems with attention to reliability, cost, and performance

Who You Are

2+ years of professional software engineering experience
Professional experience with Python (the team's primary language)
Experience working with LLM APIs (Claude, GPT, or similar) including function calling and structured outputs
Comfort with SQL for data exploration and building data-grounded AI workflows
Experience with AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Codex, or similar)
You've built something from zero to one. You're drawn to figuring out what to build, not just building what's specified.
A bias for action. You ship quickly, learn from feedback, and iterate.
You see projects through from prototype to production and care about what the client experiences, not what the code does
BS/MS in Computer Science, Mathematics, or another quantitative field, or equivalent experience

Nice to Have

Experience building agentic systems (multi-step tool use, agent orchestration, durable workflows)
Experience with additional backend languages (Java is valuable in our environment)
Familiarity with financial data (portfolios, transactions, securities, accounting)
Exposure to cloud infrastructure (AWS) and container-based deployments
Experience with evaluation frameworks or methodologies for measuring AI system quality

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
